newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel faces pay rises challenge - paper.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel faces pay rises challenge - paper.

text.p: Eurotunnel SA , the operator of the Channel tunnel, is to face criticism from shareholders this week over the remuneration of its executive directors, the Financial Times reported on Monday.

The challenge will come at an extraordinary general meeting on Thursday as the company seeks to persuade investors to support an 8.5 billion pound restructuring plan negotiated with its creditor banks, the paper said.

Christain Cambier, head of the Association of Eurotunnel shareholders, says he will question the board on the increase in senior salaries shown in the 1996 annual report, compared with those published in previous years, the paper said.
Patrick Ponsolle, co-chairman of the company, has asked Eurotunnel's auditors to report on the increase in the executive's salaries at the meeting, the paper said.
